continuity_statement: This amends my initial independent scope validation after one wording change. It is not an additional independent vote.
verdict: The revised Q146 source/ship-destination clause is explicitly supported by unchanged F01; all current Q146 clauses are mapped and mandatory. The former card-destination explicitness gap is resolved by the question wording change, without adding a card destination. All other159 question scope dispositions and all519 raw-record classifications are unchanged.

current_Q146_map.literal_question: Using the classic Filch Wild flare, what items may you illicitly take and from which locations, where may the retrieved ships go, when must the flare be revealed and when may it be zapped, what happens if caught, and what changes about the deck/discards after it is revealed?

clauses.asked_clause_paraphrase: Which items may be illicitly taken and from which locations?
Where may the retrieved ships be placed?
When must the flare be revealed?
When may the flare be zapped?
What ship cost applies if caught?
What happens to the items caught filching?
What changes about placement of the deck and discard pile after revelation?

facts.raw_key_fact: May illicitly take own ships from warp to colonies or cards from deck/discard even without entitlement.
facts.required_material: May illicitly take own ships from warp to colonies or cards from deck/discard even without entitlement.

atoms.text: May illicitly retrieve own ships from the warp even without an ordinary entitlement.
The retrieved own ships go to colonies.
May illicitly take cards from the deck or discard pile even without an ordinary entitlement.

facts.raw_key_fact: Does not need reveal unless caught, then may be zapped.
facts.required_material: Does not need reveal unless caught, then may be zapped.

atoms.text: Revelation is not required unless caught.
When caught and revealed, the flare may be zapped.

facts.raw_key_fact: If caught lose one ship to warp and return items caught filching.
facts.required_material: If caught lose one ship to warp and return items caught filching.

atoms.text: If caught, lose one ship to the warp.

facts.raw_key_fact: Once revealed deck/discards placed next to user for access.
facts.required_material: Once revealed deck/discards placed next to user for access.

atoms.text: Once revealed, place the deck and discard pile next to the user for access.

source_references.locator: Rulebook p5 printed classic Filch Wild illustration

contextual_background: Only one of standard and classic Filch flare is used; any-phase/as-any-player printed usage.
equivalents: Own ships from warp to colonies; cards from deck/discard. No additional card-destination recital is requested.
No reveal unless caught; upon being caught it can be zapped; lose one ship to warp and return the caught items; after revelation move deck/discard next to the user.

scope_validation.literal_clause_coverage: All current asked clauses map to explicit material in the four unchanged raw records.
scope_validation.card_destination: Current wording requests item sources and specifically the retrieved-ship destination. It does not ask a destination for illicitly taken cards; none is added or assumed.
scope_validation.F01_explicit_support: Own ships + warp + colonies and cards + deck/discard are explicit in raw F01 and support the complete revised source/destination clause.

old_to_new_disposition.old_literal_question: Using the classic Filch Wild flare, what items may you illicitly take and to where, when must the flare be revealed and when may it be zapped, what happens if caught, and what changes about the deck/discards after it is revealed?
old_to_new_disposition.new_literal_question: Using the classic Filch Wild flare, what items may you illicitly take and from which locations, where may the retrieved ships go, when must the flare be revealed and when may it be zapped, what happens if caught, and what changes about the deck/discards after it is revealed?

prior_finding.asked_atom: Destination of illicitly taken cosmic cards, as distinct from the already specified ship destination.
prior_finding.key_gap: F01 names deck/discard as card sources but supplies no explicit card destination. The question expressly asks to where.
prior_finding.disposition: Clarify the raw-key destination from separate authorized source validation; do not invent a destination or silently treat it as unasked.

old_to_new_disposition.current_disposition: Resolved for version08 literal scope only: item source locations and retrieved-ship destination are asked explicitly; the card destination formerly requested by broad to-where wording is no longer asked.
requested_facts_retained: colony destination for retrieved own ships
one ship to warp if caught
deck/discard placement next to user after revelation
